🔥 ya-music-desktop | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a desktop client for Yandex Music that allows users to download music and enhances the listening experience by blocking ads.
✨ Key Features: • Download music (tracks, albums, playlists) directly from the interface • Uses pywebview and Edge WebView2 for a desktop window • Downloads music in MP3 format (320/192/128 kbps) via yandex-music library • Applies ID3 tags and embeds cover art using mutagen
📖 Summary: YaMusic Desktop Client is a JavaScript-based desktop application that provides a wrapper around the Yandex Music web interface. It enhances the user experience by adding a download button for tracks, albums, and playlists, while also blocking ads and preserving user sessions.
